Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated February 1, [1937] on stationery from the Metropolitan Hotel in Nanking [Nanjing]; includes brief description of flying from Nanking to Shanghai with Eddie Smith, status of the mail contract; mentions Mr. Chu, Mr. Loh.
